summary: Tested the company modules (moduli) feature on the backend and frontend. Backend: new test_iteration22_moduli.py has 15 tests; 14 pass and 1 fails. It covers PUT /api/companies/{id}/moduli (persistence, the 422 for both areas off, the 422 for Fatturazione on with no sub-functions, archivio-only with subs off is accepted, a bad type gives 422, an unknown company gives 404, contabile and operatore get 403), GET /api/companies returning moduli for admin and non-admin, and default all-enabled for companies without moduli. It also covers enforcement per module, with GET plus POST/DELETE samples: archivio, corrispettivi, passive (/passive*, /passive-pagamenti, /scadenzario-passivo, /registro-iva-acquisti), attive (/invoices*, /pagamenti, /scadenzario, /registro-iva-vendite, /registro, /clienti/*) and fatturazione off (all of those plus /dashboard, /liquidazione-iva, /parties, /articles). Blocked calls return 403 'Modulo non attivo per questa azienda: <label>'. /company and /company/smtp are always allowed. The other company is not affected. Re-enabling restores access. The only failure: /api/ipa/search is NOT module-gated. Frontend (Playwright, desktop and mobile): the summary on the Aziende card, the dialog switches, sub-switches disabled when Fatturazione is off, the error toast when both areas are off (the dialog stays open), a successful save updates the summary and the sidebar, nav-group-attive/passive and nav-corrispettivi hide correctly, and area-switch is hidden when only one area is on. In archivio-only mode the sidebar shows the archive menu, and /dashboard, /fatture, /passive, /corrispettivi, /anagrafiche, /liquidazione-iva and /scadenzario-fornitori redirect to /archivio. In fatturazione-only mode /archivio redirects to /dashboard. Disabled routes redirect to /dashboard. Switching company with the CompanySwitcher updates the menu and redirects correctly. Dashboard SDI/scadenze/corrispettivi panels hide correctly. 2 frontend issues were found: an archivio-only navigation dead end, and dashboard content for fatture attive still shown when fatture attive is off.

minor.issue: It uses approved_user and not tenant(), so it is not gated by the Fatturazione module: it returns 200 with fatturazione off. The spec lists /api/ipa as blocked. It is not company-scoped, so the impact is low. Gate it with tenant (it needs X-Company-Id) or document the exception.

Only requires 'fatturazione'. With fatture_attive off it still returns active-invoice aggregates (fatturato, mesi, stati, recent invoices). Acceptable on the backend, but see the frontend issue below.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation dead end. With Fatturazione off and Archivio on, NAV_ARCHIVIO has no Impostazioni group (Dati azienda / Aziende / Gestione utenti), and the area-switch is hidden. So from the archive menu the admin cannot reach Aziende/Utenti/Dati azienda, and nobody can reach Dati azienda/SMTP. If they get to /impostazioni or /aziende by URL, the sidebar shows only the Impostazioni group, with no link back to the archive menu. Fix: always add the Impostazioni group (filtered by admin) to NAV_ARCHIVIO when fatturazione is off, or always add it to NAV_ARCHIVIO.

integration_issues.flow: Dashboard with fatture_attive off (for example only passive on)
integration_issues.issue: Only SdiPanel and the client ScadenzePanel are hidden. Still visible: the 'Nuova fattura' button (it links to /fatture/nuova, which just redirects back to /dashboard), the KPI 'Totale fatturato'/Imponibile/IVA/Documenti (active invoices), the 'Fatturato mensile' chart, the 'Stato SDI' status card (dashboard-status-*) and 'Ultime fatture' with 'Vedi tutte' (it links to /fatture, which redirects). Hide these when !m.fatture_attive.

Not verified in the UI. The client estratto conto and sollecito actions (/api/clienti/*) will return 403 if they are still shown on the Clienti e fornitori page. Consider hiding them when fatture_attive is off.

action_items: HIGH: In Layout.jsx, add the Impostazioni nav group (Dati azienda, plus Aziende and Gestione utenti for admin) to the archive sidebar when Fatturazione is off, and show the archive menu or a link back on settings pages for archivio-only companies.
Dashboard.jsx: when fatture_attive is off, hide the Nuova fattura button, the active KPIs, the Fatturato mensile chart, the Stato SDI card and Ultime fatture (or show passive-oriented content).
Gate /api/ipa/search by the fatturazione module (use tenant) or document the exception.
Optional: hide the client-only actions in Anagrafiche (estratto conto, sollecito) when fatture_attive is off.
critical_code_review_comments: tenant() derives the module from the first URL segment. This is a simple and robust design, but any new router or segment must be added to MODULE_SEGMENTS, otherwise it is unguarded by default (fail-open). Consider a fail-closed default for unknown segments, or an explicit per-router dependency.

Frontend RULES in lib/moduli.js duplicates the backend MODULE_SEGMENTS mapping with different path names. Keep them in sync (for example: /scadenzario$ is exact, /scadenzario-fornitori is matched by the passive rule first, and the order is significant).
Companies.jsx has `import { Button }` placed after const declarations (import/first lint). It works because imports are hoisted, but move it up.
Dashboard.jsx useEffect has [] deps. This is fine because company switching navigates or remounts, but the content gating relies on m from context while the data comes from the first fetch.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested menu, redirect and dialog flows work; the archivio-only settings dead end and the dashboard attive content are issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_T22 A/B companies (P.IVA 86999999221/86999999222), test users test-user-t22-admin/co/op and their sessions. All were deleted afterwards. The DB is back to 0 companies, and the admin account was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration22_moduli.py -n 0 (self-contained setup and cleanup). For the UI: run python3 seed_ui_t22.py seed, which prints the a/b company ids. Add the cookie session_token=test_session_t22_admin, set localStorage fe_company_id=a, and toggle the modules via /aziende -> company-moduli-{a}. Then run seed_ui_t22.py clean. Note: test_iteration4_multicompany.py fails with 'Sessione non valida' because it depends on seed_sessions.js sessions, which are not present. This is an environment issue, not a regression.
rca of the issue: Archivio-only dead end: Layout.SideContent picks NAV_ARCHIVIO when archivio mode is active, and NAV_ARCHIVIO has no settings group. AreaSwitch returns null unless both areas are on, so with fatturazione off there is no menu path to /impostazioni, /aziende or /utenti. On those paths the code picks NAV.filter(impostazioni) with no archive links. IPA: ipa_search depends on approved_user, so the MODULE_SEGMENTS 'ipa' entry is never evaluated.
